author: kycrafft
body:
So some of you may have figured out that nexus kits have been buffed/debuffed but here is just a short list of what I found was changed

Archer: buffed to 32 arrows and punch 1

Sniper: nerfed to full leather and power 1 bow and no strength

Scout: buffed with jump boost 2

Pyro: Nerfed(?) to full gold and a fire prot 1 chest plate

Barbarian: nerfed with mining fatigue 1

[Freezer may have been changed, I don't know]

My opinion is that most of these kits needed a nerf or buff. I think that sniper needed a nerf, but it's not very good now. I would suggest adding speed or more armor as power 1 isn't incredibly good. Another complaint is that pyro wasn't nerfed enough. Don't get me wrong, it's a step in the right direction, but it's pretty op still. My last opinion is that engineer and snake need nerfs. More armor and tnt for engineer would be good, and letting snake give slowness 1 when it gives poison could make the kit better

Good of job on balancing out the kits though.

replies.body: With freezer, you need to be able to move the screen.  I understand not moving (hint freezer), but you need to be able to move your screen.  So you have some defense.

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
It's probably a good thing that Barbarian has been slightly nerfed. It evens up the kits a little more but it's still quite powerful.

As for the Scout kit, the jump boost effect seems like a nice addition. Not too sure how it will affect the game-play though as I haven't tested it out yet.
